description: Everything a repository with an interface needs to write, gate and review it: the ux-quality rule (a gate, twenty non-negotiables and eleven depth files on accessibility, states, forms, text, consequential actions, AI features and verification claims), the ux-cli skill that checks a command-line tool by running it, the ux-agent-interfaces skill for JSON output, MCP servers and agent tool approval, and the ux-review skill that grades a page, a CLI or a branch by hand and reports what no tool decides.
name: ux-essentials
summary: The interface quality set: a rule for pages, apps and editor webviews, and skills for CLIs, machine-facing interfaces and on-demand UX review
